574-6754-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a 2/2 colorless Robot artifact creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-6754-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

3263-3698-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
3263-3698-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards
Repeat from step 5.
3263-3698-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

3899-6982--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When that creature enters, Stalwart Successor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

1170-2829-3836-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2829-3836-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Urza.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-804-1619-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-804-1619-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Sakashima the Impostor each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Sakashima the Impostor trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-804-1619-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

129-1409-3755-5295.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1619-2438-4605-5542-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6138.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Bloodboil Sorcerer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Bloodboil Sorcerer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2438-4605-5542-6138.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-7061-7704.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doc Samson and Solid Ground.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

5686-5961--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

677-2921-4217-5211.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
677-2921-4217-5211.description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating a Treasure token for each land you control.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lutri.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Lutri from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.
677-2921-4217-5211.notes: You can start the combo instead at step 7 if Lutri is in your graveyard. This changes the mana needed to {6}{W}{U}{B}{R}{R}{G}.

5137-5963-7287.description:
Activate Marvin using Transdimensional Bovine's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Morphling's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

338-2034-5086-5183-6291.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2034-5086-5183-6291.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

3713-4474-5078-6766.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

2530-2577-6518-6752.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-6518-6752.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Haliya, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Haliya and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Haliya trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5670-6634.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-6634.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

2979-4543-6628.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
2979-4543-6628.description:
Activate Patchwork Crawler using PuPu UFO's ability by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
If the land is mana-producing and enters the battlefield untapped, you may activate it by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Trench Behemoth's ability by returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Patchwork Crawler.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

500-1270-2523-6441.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ojer Taq and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Ojer Taq token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Ojer Taqs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2*(3^X) nonlegendary token copies of Ojer Taq that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Ojer Taqs you control.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-1270-2523-6441.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^695.6224481408007) creature tokens.

856-2267-2292-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-2267-2292-4321.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

5796-6282-6493.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
5796-6282-6493.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
You have more cards in hand than your maximum hand size.
5796-6282-6493.description:
Proceed to your next cleanup step, causing you to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Currency Converter triggers for each card discarded this way. Resolve the first trigger, exiling the discarded card.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve all remaining Currency Converter abilities, if applicable, choosing not to exile anything.
Once the stack has emptied and all players pass priority, you will still be in the cleanup step and thus need to discard cards down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.

654-880-5702.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-5702.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

341-1170-3363-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

457-1409-1418.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve both Urza triggers, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

2178-2757-3143-3490.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature that has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one other creature.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one basic land.
2178-2757-3143-3490.description:
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by sacrificing the Servo, untapping a basic land you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters among creatures you control, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control, and tap those tokens to get infinite mana from basic lands.

2511-3490-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1045-4424-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one red card in hand.
1045-4424-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Horde Ambusher.
When Horde Ambusher dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Horde Ambusher from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Horde Ambusher's morph ability by revealing a red card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

919-1742-2051-2546.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
919-1742-2051-2546.description:
Activate Lonely Sandbar's cycling ability by paying {U} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Lonely Sandbar ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card, adding {B}.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{U}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Lonely Sandbar and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

187-326.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Karok Wrangler triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

1558-2660-3592-4840.description:
Activate Planar Bridge by paying {8} and tapping it, causing you to search your library for Myr Battlesphere and put it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and the four Myr tokens.
Myr Battlesphere is put on the bottom of your library instead of in your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

913-2440-2967.description:
Activate Pashalik Mons by paying {3}{R} and sacrificing a Goblin.
The Goblin dies, triggering Pashalik Mons, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Pashalik Mons ability from step 1, creating two 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
The Goblins enter the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes twice, adding {C}{C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2773-2906-2931-4050.notablePrerequisites: You are able to cast Faceless One for {0} due to Rakdos.
2773-2906-2931-4050.description:
Cast Faceless One from the command zone by paying {0}.
Warstorm Surges triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target opponent.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Faceless One, adding one mana of any color.
Choose to have Faceless One return to command zone.
Repeat.

813-3617-3742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent can not block Phantom Steed.
813-3617-3742.description:
Cast Time Walk, taking an extra turn after this one.
Attack with Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed triggers, creating a token copy of Scholar of the Ages that is tapped and attacking.
Scholar of the Ages enters, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

2104-3554-5273.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Diabolic Tutor by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Diabolic Tutor and Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
